data.subject: Local Ledger four-week pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Daytona Street Capital's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PLBC and CFBK.

One recent signal: PLBC reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $30.4M versus $20.6M a year earlier (+47.1% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1168455/000143774926025819/0001437749-26-025819-index.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
